slides.headline: How does it work?
slides.body: Trade finance bridges the cash-flow gap between paying an overseas or domestic supplier and receiving payment from your customer. It can fund the order upfront while allowing your customer their normal payment terms, covering the trade cycle through tools like purchase order finance or letters of credit.

caption:
Growing trade volume often runs into the same wall: suppliers want payment before shipment, but customers expect their usual payment terms.

Trade finance is built for that exact gap — funding the supplier side of the transaction through tools like purchase order finance or letters of credit, so working capital isn't the ceiling on how much you can trade.

Looking to grow import or export volume? Let's talk about structuring it.
